release_notes: v0.5.0-rc10: Jobs-mode retry fix. When STT succeeds but compliance/Gemini transiently fails, the degraded call is now recoverable instead of dead. Batch 'Retry AI Analysis' requeues retryable jobs and resumes the AI/compliance stage ONLY — no STT rerun, no re-bill — repairing the existing degraded call record in place (no duplicate). Single-record retry (Needs Retry badge) requeues just the linked job the same way, and non-actionable records return clean messages instead of a raw 500. Retry buttons only appear when they can act. Includes all RC9 fixes (cost-safe cancellation + jobs-mode progress). RC10 supersedes RC9. Prerelease build for RC validation.
